frozen_baseline.purpose: new waveform inference on the complete, previously inspected SPH V1 source; independent validation is not claimed

replay.historical_scope: saved predictions and retained waveforms, not a new test cohort
success_requires: all comparable score differences within tolerance

development_selective_policy.split_unit: connected components of patients linked by exact waveform hashes
development_selective_policy.confidence: minimum absolute distance of any profile score to its released class threshold
development_selective_policy.threshold_selection: choose the floor order statistic among calibration confidence values; accept ties, report realized coverage
development_selective_policy.cascade: not implemented; no routing to a second stage and no clinical review claimed
development_selective_policy.held_partition: blocked for this policy until threshold freeze; historically inspected SPH is not independent

release_gates.independent_test: separate approval and sealed patient/signal split, source exposure audit, rights and endpoint compatibility
release_gates.other_and_auxiliary: evaluate only mapped positive and explicit compatible negative references; missing/unmappable labels remain unknown; NSR separate
release_gates.morphology_perturbation: frozen paired waveform sensitivity only; never label as a retrained ablation
release_gates.morphology_retrained_ablation: paired identical patient partitions, initial checkpoint, training schedule, seeds and calibration; freeze before locked test
release_gates.reports: aggregates and sanitized receipts only; restricted inputs and per-ECG outputs stay in CEDIA
